# Knowledge-Core: Services

## `entrypoints.catalog`

Status: `verified`

Service process entrypoints are services/gateway/main.go, services/identity/main.go, services/knowledge/main.go, and services/collaboration/src/main.rs. Service main files only create and execute application commands; Go spec files only declare application specifications. Supporting executable entrypoints include scripts/idlguard, collaboration Rust code generation, and tools/authkeys, tools/configctl, and tools/interop. Deployment definitions live under deploy and docker.

Sources: `filesystem:entrypoint-candidates`, `user-confirmed`

## `services.catalog`

Status: `verified`

Gateway is the HTTP edge and calls typed upstream clients without accessing Identity storage. Identity owns identity domain behavior and persistence. Knowledge owns document metadata, permissions, publication/public projections, attachments, trash, quotas, and outbox in the PostgreSQL knowledge schema, but not Yjs binary state. Collaboration is the Rust Volo Thrift and WebSocket/Yrs service; it owns collaboration state in its PostgreSQL schema and rechecks document access through Knowledge RPC.

Sources: `filesystem:service-definitions`, `user-confirmed`
